CheckTitle: Firewall blocks Cassandra ingress from the internet
Description: Linode Firewalls are checked to ensure they block **Cassandra** (port(s) [7199, 9160, 8888]) ingress from the internet (0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0).
Risk: Allowing unrestricted Cassandra access from the internet exposes services to **brute-force attacks** and **exploitation**.
